extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models on interactive visual code generation, containing 1,825 diverse tasks across nine domains (games, SVG generation, web applications, simulations, data science, management systems, multimedia editing, quick tools, and others). The benchmark assesses visual fidelity and interactive integrity through automated multimodal evaluation using temporal screenshots and checklist-guided scoring.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Multi-stage pipeline involving sourcing from expert showcases, open datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots; followed by automated filtering, de-duplication, prompt rewriting, checklist generation with human refinement, and solvability validation. Includes two-stage de-duplication using MinHash/semantic similarity and screenshot perceptual hashing, with expert and LLM-assisted prompt rewriting verified by humans.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Candidates from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and screenshots processed through LLM visual-to-query conversion. Raw data includes prompts, checklists, normalized DOM/CSS/JS code, and screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Experts rewrite prompts for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify. Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. Checklists are LLM-drafted and then human-refined for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen's κ ≥0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references. Difficulty is assigned post hoc by aggregated performance of 30+ models. Sub-categories are tagged by a lightweight classifier with human spot-checks.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Cohen's κ ≥0.8 among annotators for checklist calibration. Human study with 280-instance, six-model validation demonstrating high pairwise agreement (targeting >90%) between automated referee and human experts. Cross-validation of final rankings against WebDev Arena to ensure alignment with real-world user preferences.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Checklists generated by Hunyuan-Turbos LLM and human-refined. Lightweight classifier for sub-category tagging with human spot-checks. Dual-referee setup using Qwen2.5-VL-72B (open-source) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (proprietary) for automated evaluation. LLM rewriting for prompt diversity.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark focuses on visual code generation evaluation and may not capture all aspects of code quality. Current evaluation tools do not holistically judge visual fidelity and dynamics, forming a bottleneck.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The benchmark is designed for evaluating large language models on visual code generation tasks, including interactive web interfaces, data visualizations, and mini-games. It provides automated evaluation of visual fidelity and interactive integrity.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The benchmark is open-sourced and available at https://artifactsbenchmark.github.io, including the benchmark, evaluation harness, and baseline results.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Difficulty calibration performed post hoc by aggregating performance of 30+ models to enforce 30%/40%/30% split (Easy/Medium/Hard), realized as 559/611/655 items. Prompts rewritten by experts for clarity/completeness/executability and by LLM for diverse styles with human verification. Sub-categories tagged by lightweight classifier with human spot-checks.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automated filtering to drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics. Two-stage de-duplication: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts. Underspecified items pruned during solvability validation; tasks solved only by brittle hacks revised or removed. Standardized execution with headless Chromium at 1024×768 resolution with deterministic seeds.
